Removed candidate*Reaction, candidate*ReturningArrows/Cycle, candidate*Possibility(Accepted), candidate*EmotionRepeatsSibling-driven clarification branches, and candidate*SameSituation prompts -- verified via full-repo grep that none of these are read by worksheet bindings, homework UI, or any test that asserts real S01 protocol content (only generic/synthetic tests reuse 'candidateOneReaction' as an arbitrary field-name string, unaffected). Retained candidateOneEmotion/Behavior, candidateTwoEmotion/Behavior, candidateThreeEmotion/Behavior, candidateOneThought/TwoThought/ThreeThought (now set deterministically), and threePersonModelInsight (now a single merged prompt instead of two) because worksheet-bindings/tbct-s01.ts and worksheet-renderers/s01-worksheet.tsx (both still out of scope, not edited) read exactly those field names. dialogue-agent-expansion.test.ts added to allowedPaths because it asserts on the node title 'First Candidate Full Cycle' and prompt id 'candidate-one-thought', both of which stop existing once the thought is counselor-stated rather than elicited -- updated the same two assertions to the new equivalent (candidate-one-emotion, now the real participant-owned content field) without weakening what the test verifies (participant-owned/assistantMustNotSupply classification of a real content field vs. an administrative gate field). Left Phase 1 (mandatory-opening / situation-thought-distinction, i.e. the early telegraphic-situation elicitation) structurally unchanged: it is already a 2-turn opening and is protected by two regression tests in src/lib/api/runtime-source-fidelity.test.ts (out of scope, not edited) that assert its exact overwrite-prevention behavior -- reported as a Manual-vs-code / scope tension rather than silently restructured. Left Phase 4 (personal-returning-arrows), Phase 5 (participant-summary), Phase 6 (cognitive-distortions), and Phase 7 (daily-observation-closing) structurally unchanged: the user's instructions for these phases were directional/structural, not concrete replacement content the way Phase 2 was, and none of them are part of the branch-explosion problem this pass targets.
note2026_08_17b_s01_phase_aware_fallback: Follow-up task, three limited goals on top of the 2026-08-17 Neutral Example simplification (not reverted). (1) repeatedFallback S01-only exception: runtime-orchestrator.ts's generic 'share one specific moment' override (triggered when the dialogue agent falls back 3x to identical approved text) is now routed through a new exported resolveRepeatedFallbackOverride() helper. For sessionDefinitionId 'tbct-s01' it delegates to a new resolveRepeatedFallbackText() in static-messages/s01.ts (a per-prompt-id rephrase table + a phase-neutral 'let's try that more simply' default that never asks about a new personal situation); for every other session it returns the byte-identical original override string -- verified by an added regression test. This is the S01-only exception the task requires while leaving S02-S08 behavior provably unchanged. (2) Worksheet Candidate->Person label change (worksheet-bindings/tbct-s01.ts, worksheet-renderers/s01-worksheet.tsx, both newly added to allowedPaths for this reason): user-facing 'Candidate 1/2/3' -> 'Person 1/2/3' / '사람 1/2/3', internal candidate* field names NOT renamed. (3) S01 Opening redesign per explicit user instruction: situation-thought-distinction node gained a new 'initial-thought-probe' prompt (field openingInitialThought) that asks for the participant's automatic thought about the situation they just described, run BEFORE the Neutral Example (previously no S01 field captured this at all). personal-returning-arrows node's 5 link-recognition prompts (thought-to-emotion/emotion-to-behavior/behavior-to-situation/situation-to-thought/outcome-gap) were replaced with 3 discrete personal-emotion/personal-behavior/personal-body prompts (fields personalEmotion, personalBehavior, personalBodySensations) that reuse the situation+thought already captured in Opening instead of re-asking them -- verified via full-repo grep that outcome-gap's activationCondition field (fearedOutcomeDidNotMaterialize) was never set anywhere in the codebase (a pre-existing dead branch, same class of issue as S02's documented dead 'returningParticipant' branch) so removing it drops no reachable behavior, and that personalSituationThoughtLink/outcomeGapInsight have no worksheet binding. personalThoughtEmotionLink/personalEmotionBehaviorLink/personalBehaviorSituationLink DID have worksheet bindings (box-personal-1/2/3, 'Thought -> Emotion' etc.) -- since this task explicitly brought worksheet-bindings/tbct-s01.ts and s01-worksheet.tsx into scope for the Candidate->Person relabel (goal 2 above), those three boxes were re-pointed at the new personalEmotion/personalBehavior/personalBodySensations fields (relabeled 'My emotion' / 'My behavior' / 'My body' accordingly) in the same pass rather than left pointing at now-orphaned fields. (4) Shared-file exception, justified per the manual's escalation process: runtime-context.ts's isMeaningfulTextResponse() NON_ANSWER_TEXT blacklist rejected literal uncertainty expressions ('idk', 'i don't know', 'i dont know', 'i do not know', '몰라', '모르겠어요', '잘 모르겠어요', 'não sei', 'nao sei') as non-answers on EVERY free-text prompt across all 8 sessions, before any session-specific dispatch -- confirmed via repo-wide grep that no test asserts rejection of these specific phrases (session-fidelity-fixtures.ts's `insufficientPatientInputs` fixture that includes '몰라'/'잘 모르겠어요' is declared but never imported/used by any test). This directly blocked this task's explicit, repeated requirement (see redesign brief: uncertainty on openingInitialThought/personalEmotion/etc. must be accepted, not treated as invalid, and must never deadlock toward MAX_CLARIFICATION_ATTEMPTS) -- there is no session-local way to satisfy it since the rejection happens deterministically before extractRuntimeState ever knows which session/field is active. Fix removed only the 'I don't know' family from the blacklist (greeting/filler entries like hi/test/안녕/네/좋아요 are untouched); this is an additive relaxation in the same direction, and using the same early-return pattern, as the existing 2026-08-14 boolean/enum-kind fix already recorded in this file's prior note. Applies to all 8 sessions (any free-text prompt now accepts a literal 'I don't know' as a genuine uncertain answer instead of always rejecting it) -- flagged prominently in the final report as a cross-session behavior change, not something to discover later. New test files: src/lib/protocol/sessions/s01.test.ts (Opening flow OP-1..OP-7) and src/lib/runtime/runtime-orchestrator.test.ts (repeatedFallback RF-1..RF-7, including explicit S02 byte-identical regression). (5) Second small shared-file addition to isMeaningfulTextResponse in the same runtime-context.ts edit as (4): openingInitialThought (like several other single-field free-text prompts with no validation.kind) never reaches the semantic-assessment path, so a literal meta-question ('Why are you asking this?') was being accepted and stored verbatim as if it were the participant's actual thought, instead of triggering the dialogue agent's own explain_rationale handling (see src/test/fakes/dialogue-agent.fake.ts's matching 'why are/do you ask' pattern, already present before this task). Added one more narrow, pattern-matched non-answer check mirroring the existing 'could/can/would you rephrase' check immediately above it in the same function -- same category of fix, not a new mechanism. Verified with OP-3 in s01.test.ts.

S04-S08 (and every other S01/S02/S03 field) now get the exact pre-2026-08-17 legacy behavior for both cases. Verified with the 5 required inputs ('잘 모르겠어요.', '왜 물어보세요?', '그게 무슨 말이에요?', '네.', '기분이 안 좋았어요.') exercised against S01's openingInitialThought and a representative field from each of S04-S08 in a new dedicated file, src/lib/runtime/runtime-context-session-scope.test.ts (kept separate from the existing, out-of-scope runtime-context.test.ts rather than expanding that file's scope), plus the full Sessions 01-08 simulated audit and the existing s01.test.ts OP-3/OP-5 assertions (unaffected, since both still target openingInitialThought).
